name: paper_resolver_skill
description: Resolve a paper identifier (arxiv/doi/openreview/local) to S2 metadata + optional full text, or run a Semantic Scholar keyword search. Single skill, two modes: 'resolve' for one known paper, 'search' for keyword lookup. Full-text extraction (verbosity >= 1) uses a two-tier cascade: Tier 1 arXiv source (.tar.gz → cleaned LaTeX/Markdown, equations preserved) → Tier 2 pdfplumber (PDF text, degraded; the compression LLM reconstructs equations). The chosen tier is reported on the response as data.extraction_method (one of 'arxiv_source' / 'pdfplumber_llm' / 'abstract_only') — downstream consumers use it as a trust signal for equation/pseudocode reliability. Never raises — every exit returns a {status, data, message} envelope; malformed direct verbosity, limit, or offset values and unhashable cache-key inputs return an error envelope without a network request.

mode.description: Skill dispatch mode. 'resolve' fetches one paper by identifier; 'search' runs an S2 keyword query and returns a list of matched papers (metadata-only by default — no per-result PDF fetch).

source_type.description: Resolve-mode only: identifier scheme. Ignored when mode='search'.

identifier.description: Resolve-mode only: arXiv ID (e.g. '2406.04378'), DOI, OpenReview URL, or repo-relative path. Ignored when mode='search'.

verbosity.description: Depth of resolution. 0 = S2 metadata only (no full-text fetch); data.extraction_method = 'abstract_only'. 1 = metadata + full text via the two-tier cascade (arXiv source → pdfplumber), later compressed to PaperExtract by the lit-review node. 2 = same cascade as 1 but the full extracted text is also retained on the response. Resolve-mode default 1; search-mode default 0 (fan-out cost trap otherwise).

query.description: Search-mode only: keyword query string. Ignored when mode='resolve'.

limit.description: Search-mode only: maximum results to return. Default 10, hard-capped at 50.

year.description: Search-mode optional filter: publication-year filter as accepted by the S2 search endpoint (e.g. '2020', '2019-2023', '2018-').

fields_of_study.description: Search-mode optional filter: comma-separated S2 fieldsOfStudy values (e.g. 'Computer Science,Physics').

publication_types.description: Search-mode optional filter: comma-separated S2 publicationTypes values (e.g. 'JournalArticle,Conference').

min_citation_count.description: Search-mode optional filter: minimum citation count, mapped to the S2 minCitationCount query param.
